**Finding: deviation (INDEMN)**

Array's indemnity of Ono exists (§16.2) but covers only Array's own Array Territory commercialization, Array-sponsored clinical studies, and breach of Array's Article 15 reps. There is **no third-party IP infringement indemnity**, §15.4 disclaims any non-infringement warranty, and §11.4(a) leaves each Party to defend patent Infringement Actions "in its sole discretion and at its own expense" — so as licensee we absorb all freedom-to-operate risk on Array's own compounds and patents. That fails even the fallback position (licensor IP indemnity with usual exclusions).

Our own indemnity in §16.1 is properly limited to our Ono Territory acts, studies and Article 15 breaches, so no narrowing was needed. Procedure (§16.3), allocation (§16.4) and the consequential-damages carve-out (§16.5) are already standard.

Redline (validated, ok:true): new §16.2(e) adding an Array IP indemnity with customary modification/combination carve-outs, expressly overriding the §11.4 cost allocation for such claims, with an invitation to discuss a cap or §16.4-style allocation as a fallback.
